_comment: Start-up thresholds (scripts/ci/startup-bench.mjs, scripts/bench/busy-host.mjs). Each is a recorded baseline plus a measured noise margin (ER-12): the median of 19 invocations of 5 starts each of the debug .app on the Mac mini, 2026-11-16, at idle and under yes/dd stress, and 3 standard deviations of those medians. The measurement and the commands are the results block 'Start-up benchmark on a busy host' in apps/debrief/docs/performance.md. Times are ms since the process start (marks) and ms of CPU (user + sys) of the app's process tree at firstInteractive (cpu). samples.maxSpread: 3 times the worst spread of the middle half (P75 - P25) / median of the 5 starts' CPU measured (0.102); over it the result is NOT MEASURED (extreme load). reference: the fixed workload's best idle time; normaliseWall false because it was measured not to track the app under load (docs/performance.md). Linux reports only until its first nightly numbers are recorded here.
